title: Choosing FeeIn is always more beneficial than FeeOut
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low, the difference is very small for the majority of swaps  **Likelihood:** High, FeeIn can be chosen on every swap  ## Description  Users can choose between `FeeIn` (fee on tokenIn-amountIn), or choose `FeeOut` (fee on tokenOut-amountOut). If both alternatives are calculated it always happens that choosing `FeeIn` always results in fewer fees (the user receives more net amountOut).
